about_the_game:
Scientific Software Solutions Capital Account System (SSSCAS) is a next generation capital account system kernel designed to account for up to 18 quintillion units, with a limit of 100 quadrillion units per transaction.

SSSCAS is written in C++, the next generation capital account software language, replacing older COBOL based CAS systems.

SSSCAS utilizes dynamic array technology, allowing allocation of memory space dynamically as needed by the computer as new accounts are created.

SSSCAS may be used as a standalone application, or integrated via console input and output APIs with other financial technology (fintech) software.

SSSCAS was developed independently by Michael James Coffey, who holds an ACT Science score of 36.

Bring your capital account system to the next level with Scientific Software Solutions Capital Account System SSSCAS.
